nphi.title: MPX-RESPONSE – Clinical research network to improve the management of mpox
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Fundación Huésped; Oslo University Hospital; ECRAID; UMC Utrecht; Erasmus MC; University of Antwerp; University of Verona; APHP; PANDEMIC platform
nphi.summary: Horizon Europe clinical research network studying mpox treatment and management, including trials and cohorts in Europe and Latin America, with Fiocruz and the Norwegian Institute of Public Health as participants.

nphi.title: EACCR2 – Eastern Africa Consortium for Clinical Research 2
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); Addis Ababa University; Karolinska Institutet; ITM Antwerp; AIGHD; Radboudumc; University of Oxford; UCL; KCMC; University of Khartoum; University of Rwanda
nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence coordinated by Uganda's national health research organisation to strengthen clinical trial and research capacity across Eastern Africa. Tanzania's NIMR and KEMRI were partners alongside European…

nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK); Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Instituto Butantan; LSHTM; Erasmus MC; ITM Antwerp; Universidad del Valle; Swiss TPH
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 consortium researching Zika virus complications and building a sustainable Latin American research network for emerging-disease preparedness. NPHI-type partners include Fiocruz, Cuba's IPK and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: ZIKAlliance – A global alliance for Zika virus control and prevention
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP Mexico); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Institut Pasteur; Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social; Universidad Industrial de Santander; Institut Louis Malardé (French Polynesia); Bernhard-Nocht-Institut
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 multidisciplinary consortium of 50+ partners studying Zika virus natural history, pregnancy outcomes and vector control across Latin America and the Caribbean. NPHIs from Brazil, Mexico, Norway and France took part.

nphi.title: GOARN_CC_II – WHO Collaborating Centre for GOARN
nphi.with: WHO / GOARN Operational Support Team (Geneva)
nphi.summary: RKI operates as WHO Collaborating Centre supporting GOARN partners in outbreak preparedness and response through training, workforce development, community engagement and network partnerships.

nphi.title: EAVI – European-African Vaccine Initiative against chikungunya in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, trial sponsor); Ifakara Health Institute (scientific lead); Valneva Austria; EPFL; Karolinska Institutet
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 partnership running a phase IIIb chikungunya vaccine trial in Kenya and Tanzania and preparing master protocols for future NTD vaccine trials; Spain's ISCIII and KEMRI participate.

nphi.title: Africa CDC – IOM partnership on mobility and health security (2026–2028)
nphi.with: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
nphi.summary: Agreement covering 2026–2028 on preparedness and response for migrants and mobile populations, surveillance and health measures at points of entry, and cross-border early warning and information sharing.

nphi.title: IANPHI–WMO MoU and heat-health indicator declaration
nphi.actor: IANPHI (Climate Change and Public Health Thematic Committee)
nphi.with: World Meteorological Organization (Geneva); committee chaired by Santé publique France
nphi.summary: IANPHI's climate committee helped sign an MoU with WMO in December 2025, after a joint workshop in London in July 2025. An AFD-funded workshop in Lyon in November 2025 produced a draft NPHI declaration on heat-health indicators, due for…

nphi.title: RKI/WHO Hub framework on modelling-to-policy pathways, tested in Singapore (2026)
nphi.with: WHO Hub; LSHTM; National University of Singapore (Saw Swee Hock SPH); University of Oxford Pandemic Sciences Institute; Singapore MOH PREPARE
nphi.summary: RKI's ZIG, the WHO Hub and LSHTM built an evaluation framework for how infectious-disease modelling informs policy, earlier applied to WHO's mpox analytics in DRC and tested in Singapore with NUS in 2026.

nphi.title: ICMR – SNSF Letter of Intent (with DBT)
nphi.with: Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)
nphi.summary: Letter of intent between ICMR, DBT and the Swiss National Science Foundation to promote joint health research.

nphi.title: Africa CDC – UNAIDS MoU on health security and community health systems
nphi.with: UNAIDS
nphi.summary: MoU signed 26 Sept 2025 in New York covering community health workers, epidemic preparedness, HIV transition and local manufacturing.

nphi.title: Africa CDC – IFRC three-year MoU
nphi.with: IFRC
nphi.summary: MoU of 22 May 2025 on outbreak response, preparedness, community health workforce and surveillance, expanding a 2021 agreement.

nphi.title: Bio-Manguinhos–MPP MoU on next-generation mRNA vaccines
nphi.with: Medicines Patent Pool (MPP); WHO/MPP mRNA Technology Transfer Programme; Afrigen (South Africa)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in September 2024 under the WHO/MPP mRNA Technology Transfer Programme for Bio-Manguinhos to build an RNA vaccine pipeline for endemic and epidemic diseases, test new lipids and support technology transfer to Afrigen and other…

nphi.title: Health Security Partnership to Strengthen Disease Surveillance in Africa (HSPA)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO (Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence); Canada Weapons Threat Reduction Program; UK government
nphi.summary: WHO, Africa CDC and RKI link health and security sectors for collaborative surveillance (biorisk, event- and indicator-based and genomic surveillance, epidemic intelligence). Phase 1 covered six countries from 2023; phase 2 (2025-2028)…

nphi.title: RBC – FIND collaboration agreement on diagnostics
nphi.with: FIND (Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics)
nphi.summary: Agreement of Nov 2023 on diagnostic innovation, regional diagnostics manufacturing and genomic surveillance, plus community screening and malaria test research.

nphi.title: WHO – China CDC training on intelligent public health and open-source epidemic intelligence (EIOS)
nphi.with: World Health Organization (EIOS); delegates from WHO Western Pacific Region member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's Global Public Health Center and WHO hold a yearly training for Western Pacific public health staff on EIOS open-source epidemic intelligence, multi-source surveillance data and rapid risk assessment. The 2025 round, the third,…

nphi.title: RKI – WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence MoU and workplans
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence (WHO)
nphi.summary: RKI and the WHO Hub signed an MoU in 2021 and run a joint workplan on genomic surveillance via NPHIs, EIOS public health intelligence, AMR/HAI and the GOARN Berlin Fellowship. A steering committee met in Berlin in April 2024.

nphi.title: ICMR – GARDP MoU on antibiotic development
nphi.with: Global Antibiotic Research and Development Partnership (GARDP)
nphi.summary: ICMR and GARDP agreed to cooperate on research and development of antibiotics addressing drug resistance.

nphi.title: Global Laboratory Leadership Programme (GLLP)
nphi.with: WHO; ECDC; FAO; WOAH (OIE); Association of Public Health Laboratories; implementing countries incl. Pakistan and Liberia
nphi.summary: CDC co-developed the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme with WHO, ECDC, APHL, FAO and WOAH. Its One Health learning package trains national laboratory leaders and has been rolled out in countries including Pakistan and Liberia.

nphi.title: ICMR – DNDi MoU on neglected disease drugs
nphi.with: Drugs for Neglected Diseases initiative (DNDi)
nphi.summary: Long-running MoU (2015, renewed 2020 and again in October 2025) on drug R&D for neglected diseases.

nphi.title: Global Health Security Initiative (GHSI)
nphi.with: Global Health Security Initiative (G7 + Mexico health ministries, European Commission; WHO observer)
nphi.summary: An informal partnership of the G7 countries, Mexico and the European Commission (with WHO as observer) on health security, launched at a ministerial meeting in Ottawa in 2001. Its working groups include a laboratory network, pandemic…

nphi.title: Global Public Health Intelligence Network (GPHIN) early-warning partnership with WHO
nphi.with: World Health Organization (WHO); Nuclear Threat Initiative (co-launch of GPHIN II)
nphi.summary: GPHIN, built by Health Canada with WHO and now run by PHAC, scans global media in several languages for signals of outbreaks and other public health threats, and feeds alerts to WHO and other international users.

nphi.title: NIPD – Swiss TPH strategic partnership on tropical diseases
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute (Swiss TPH)
nphi.summary: A long-standing partnership on tropical disease research, control and training. A 2025 Swiss TPH leadership visit to NIPD reaffirmed cooperation on talent development and international research.

nphi.title: Symposium on Surveillance-Response Systems Leading to Tropical Disease Elimination
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute; WHO; regional NTD/malaria networks
nphi.summary: Recurring international symposium co-organised by NIPD and Swiss TPH on surveillance-response systems for eliminating tropical diseases. The 2026 Shanghai edition also hosted annual meetings of China–Africa and Asian schistosomiasis,…

nphi.title: EPIC – genomic surveillance capacity in five African countries (RKI/WHO Hub, with IGS Summer School)
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; national partner institutions in the five countries
nphi.summary: RKI's WHO Hub Office builds pathogen sequencing and genomic surveillance capacity in five African countries, including a two-week ZIG-IGS Summer School using fictional outbreak exercises and promoting South-South networking.

nphi.title: SAPHIR – public health intelligence training and EIOS noise-reduction pilots
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO EMRO
nphi.summary: RKI and the WHO Hub train pilot countries in public health intelligence and develop AI-based noise reduction for the EIOS platform.

nphi.title: Kuwait CDC – EMPHNET needs assessment for a national FETP
nphi.with: EMPHNET; WHO EMRO
nphi.summary: The Kuwait Centre for Disease Control worked with EMPHNET and WHO EMRO on a needs assessment to inform setting up a national FETP.

nphi.title: EPHI national EIOS capacity-building workshop
nphi.with: WHO (with ECHO funding)
nphi.summary: EPHI organised a 10-14 March 2025 national EIOS training in Adama for 22 participants, with WHO technical support and platform and EU ECHO funding.

nphi.title: Tracking heat health impacts expert workshop (London, June 2025)
nphi.with: Robert Koch Institute; IANPHI; LSHTM; GHHIN; WHO; WMO; Lancet Countdown
nphi.summary: GHHIN, IANPHI, Santé publique France, RKI and LSHTM convened 40+ participants, including NPHAs from 17 countries, to draft common standards and indicators for measuring heat-related illness and deaths.

nphi.title: WHO AFRO regional consultation on strengthening National Public Health Agencies (Accra, 2025)
nphi.with: WHO African Region and WHO Ghana; Ghana Health Service
nphi.summary: High-level consultation hosted in Ghana with Africa CDC, Ghana Health Service and ministries to map NPHA landscapes, refine a core-capabilities framework with African input and strengthen partnerships.

nphi.title: KDCA-run GOARN tiered training for Korean responders (2024)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: GOARN (WHO); University of Western Australia; National Medical Center Korea
nphi.summary: KDCA held a multi-tier GOARN training programme from March 2024 in Seoul for 33 KDCA and National Medical Center staff, facilitated with a University of Western Australia expert; KDCA is a GOARN partner but had made no deployments by 2024.

nphi.title: China CDC – GOARN Tier 1.5 and training-of-trainers workshop for Asian responders
nphi.with: WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN); Guangdong Provincial CDC; national public health agencies of the participating countries
nphi.summary: China CDC and GOARN ran a three-day workshop in Guangzhou on deploying international public health emergency teams. It covered GOARN Tier 1.5 training and training of trainers for participants from eight ASEAN countries, Sri Lanka and…

nphi.title: WHO CC GOARN II – Operation of WHO Collaborating Centre for GOARN
nphi.with: WHO; GOARN
nphi.summary: RKI support to GOARN on surveillance, outbreak response leadership and training.

nphi.title: WHOCC-AMR – Coordination of the WHO AMR surveillance collaborating centres network
nphi.with: WHO HQ (AMR Division; IPC Global Unit); WHO AMR Surveillance and Quality Assessment Collaborating Centres Network; WHO Global IPC Network
nphi.summary: Coordinated the global WHO network of AMR surveillance and quality assessment centres supporting LMICs.

nphi.title: Health-security partnership to strengthen disease surveillance and epidemic intelligence in Africa
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded project (2023–2024), delivered through ASLM, that supported WHO and Africa CDC on country partnerships, a regional bio-surveillance framework for high-risk pathogens, and early-warning and epidemic-intelligence training.

nphi.title: IANPHI–WHO agreement on NPHI creation and development
nphi.with: World Health Organization (WHO)
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI and WHO signed what IANPHI calls a historic agreement to support creating and developing NPHIs, with a two-year joint action plan to follow.

nphi.title: ICMR – FIND MoU on diagnostics
nphi.with: FIND (Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics)
nphi.summary: MoU listed by ICMR as signed 15 Feb 2021 with the diagnostics foundation FIND; purpose not described on the page.

nphi.title: WHO AMR CC Network – Coordination of WHO AMR surveillance collaborating centres network
nphi.with: WHO; WHO AMR Collaborating Centres
nphi.summary: Coordinated WHO CCs supporting GLASS AMR surveillance in LMICs.

nphi.title: GOPA – GOARN – Postgraduate Training for Applied Epidemiology collaboration
nphi.with: WHO (GOARN)
nphi.summary: Linked GOARN with RKI's PAE field epidemiology training via secondments and deployments.

nphi.title: Welsh Government – WHO/Europe collaboration agreement on health equity
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (Venice Office); Welsh Government
nphi.summary: Agreement between the Welsh Government and WHO/Europe, implemented by Public Health Wales, on health equity solutions, well-being economy approaches and capacity building; renewed in 2023.

nphi.title: SHARP JA – Strengthened International Health Regulations and Preparedness
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Wales (UK partner); THL (coordinator); RIVM; NIJZ; AGES; Switzerland took part as a collaborating partner with its own funding
nphi.summary: A joint action to help countries implement the International Health Regulations and strengthen preparedness for serious cross-border health threats, including laboratory capacity and chemical threats.

nphi.title: SYSVAC – Global registry of systematic reviews on vaccines
nphi.with: WHO (Switzerland); London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (UK)
nphi.summary: Built a free registry of vaccine systematic reviews and e-learning for NITAGs.

nphi.title: IHR-PVS Toolbox – Toolboxes bridging IHR and PVS
nphi.with: WHO (Switzerland); World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE/WOAH)
nphi.summary: Supported WHO in developing toolboxes (e.g. rabies) to align IHR and veterinary services capacities.

nphi.title: WHO CC GOARN – Operationalisation of WHO Collaborating Centre for GOARN
nphi.with: GOARN at WHO; GOARN Outbreak Response Leadership Training Working Group
nphi.summary: Supported GOARN 2.0 strategy and Tier 3 leadership training.

nphi.title: EIOS epidemic intelligence tool introduced at NCDC Nigeria
nphi.with: WHO; US CDC
nphi.summary: WHO and US CDC trained 28 mostly NCDC staff in Abuja (31 Oct 2019) as Nigeria became the first African country to adopt EIOS for event-based surveillance.

nphi.title: Switzerland–Iran declaration of intent on public health cooperation
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Medical Education of Iran
nphi.summary: FOPH concluded a declaration of intent with Iran to strengthen bilateral cooperation in public health.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Sierra Leone Country Grant (human health, WHO)
nphi.with: National Public Health Agency (NPHA); Ministry of Health; Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security; FAO; Connaught Hospital; Ola During Children's Hospital
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund support implemented by WHO with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and National Public Health Agency built microbiology labs, stewardship training and the country's first GLASS AMR data submission.

nphi.title: Switzerland–China health cooperation agreement
nphi.with: Chinese health and regulatory authorities
nphi.summary: FOPH cooperation agreement with China covering food, medicines, medical devices and cosmetics.

nphi.title: Phase 3 'Ebola ça suffit' ring-vaccination trial of Canada's VSV-EBOV vaccine in Guinea
nphi.with: WHO; Guinea Ministry of Health; Norwegian Institute of Public Health (NIPH); MSF/Epicentre; IDRC; CIHR
nphi.summary: Canada (PHAC, IDRC, CIHR, DFATD) supported the WHO and Guinea Ministry of Health Phase 3 trial of the PHAC-developed VSV-EBOV Ebola vaccine. Canadian experts advised on safety monitoring and helped build Guinean research capacity.

nphi.title: PHAC epidemiologist deployment via GOARN to the Philippines (Typhoon Haiyan response)
nphi.with: Philippine Department of Health; WHO / GOARN
nphi.summary: PHAC, a founding GOARN member, sent an epidemiologist to the WHO-led response team in the Philippines in November 2013 to help the Department of Health with post-disaster disease surveillance and risk assessment.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 027 – Bio-risk management in Laos and Thailand
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Laos; WHO; Expertise France; Thai Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: EU-funded project with Institut Pasteur, Institut Pasteur du Laos and WHO introducing laboratory biorisk management to Thailand's public health laboratory network and strengthening biosafety policy in Laos.

nphi.title: APARET – African Programme for Advanced Research Epidemiology Training (EU FP7)
nphi.actor: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: AFENET; Makerere University; University of Ghana; KNUST; Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo; University of Zimbabwe; MUHAS; Ahmadu Bello University; Swiss TPH; WHO; National Foundation for the CDC
nphi.summary: EU-funded programme (2011-2014) supporting FETP graduates in Africa to become independent researchers through mentoring, workshops and small grants.

nphi.title: WHO Collaborating Centre on Chronic Noncommunicable Disease Policy (PHAC)
nphi.with: WHO HQ; PAHO (CARMEN network and CARMEN Policy Observatory)
nphi.summary: PHAC hosts the WHO Collaborating Centre on chronic NCD policy, first designated in 1994. Its work includes policy research, training, co-leading the CARMEN Policy Observatory with PAHO, and supporting WHO NCD networks.
